The conventional-cell lattice is the near-ambient measurement of the EOS specimen in Ross and Angel (1999). Fractional coordinates are from the twin-corrected Pbnm refinement of Sasaki et al. (1983). The four occupied Wyckoff orbits give Ca4Ge4O12 (Z=4). The numerical 298 K EOS reference is an operational encoding of the source's qualitative room-temperature statement, not a reported thermometer reading.
